necessity_paragraph: The claim for CPT 93229 was denied under code CO-197 due to missing precertification. The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10) alongside nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current management strategies.
